title: Story log: early builds reach their places; retry failed shots
body:
The story log's first photos were all title screens: until early November `?at=` only worked in development builds (`import.meta.env.DEV && …get('at')`), and the recorder makes production builds. 46 of the 74 commits were like that.

- Those commits are now built with `NODE_ENV=development`, the one way to reach a place on them; each record's `camera.build` says which mode was used.
- `--retry-shots` (and the workflow's `retry_shots` input) re-records every change whose photos failed or fell back to the title screen. Builds that had no `?at=` at all (the first commit) are skipped, since a title is all they can show.
- A re-record with `--no-shots` never drops existing photos.

Tried locally on the story branch: Oct 18's Junction now shows the street (summer green, before the fall colours) instead of the title.
